seo.title: Case Study: Nurani Timepieces — Website for a Watch Brand | Máximo Silva
seo.description: How I built the online catalog for Nurani Timepieces, a premium imported watch brand, with collections for men and women and lead generation.

hero.title: Nurani Timepieces — from scattered catalog to
hero.subtitle: A premium watch brand specializing in imported products that needed its own online presence to showcase its collections and attract potential customers.

desafio.title: The Challenge
desafio.texto: Nurani sold premium imported watches, but had no space of its own to showcase its collections in an organized way. It relied on social media to display its catalog, making it hard for new customers to explore the products and build trust before reaching out.

solucion.title: The Solution
solucion.texto: I designed and built a web catalog with separate collections for men and women, adding a contact form with a discount incentive to capture interested visitors and turn them into real inquiries.
incluye: Catalog with collections for men and women
Product pages with photos and key details
Premium design matching the brand's positioning
Structure designed to convert visitors into leads

resultado.title: The Result
resultado.texto: The brand now has a professional platform to present its collections, strengthen its digital presence, and convert visitors into potential customers, without relying solely on social media.
